name: DCA Smokejumpers Grill Crispy Chicken Tenders & Crinkle/Waffle Fries (Allergy-Friendly Option)
brandOrRestaurant: Smokejumpers Grill (Grizzly Peak · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Smokejumpers Grill has a dedicated allergy fryer line and offers both regular white-meat Chicken Tenders and **Gluten/Dairy-Allergy-Friendly Chicken Tenders & Fries** in the Disneyland Mobile Order app!
prepOrOrderInstructions: In the Disneyland App under Smokejumpers Grill, scroll to the **Gluten/Milk Allergy-Friendly** menu if you want dairy-free, gluten-free chicken tenders and fries.
watchOuts: Peel off any extra-crispy breading ends if sensitive to fryer oil
